title: Robust Belief Sharing in Federated Active Inference: A Recovery-Tested Generalized-Variational Framework for Categorical Contamination-Aware Consensus
description: The selected Active Fedference 1.1.0 manuscript presents a discrete-categorical connection between active-inference belief sharing and a generalized-Bayes family. It separately assigns claims to source-conditional client updates, a recovery-only heuristic server rule and an objective-backed variational server rule; no robustness guarantee transfers between those axes. The manuscript reports recovery, contamination, sensitivity and socket-backed studies from deterministic artifacts. This catalog refresh does not reproduce those studies or establish general robustness or real-world deployment efficacy.
